title: Floor show at the EM Club — the floor routine
description: The dancer lies back on a pink cloth spread over the plywood floor, red fabric pooled beside her, while the front row leans in and one soldier reaches out with a bill in his hand. Boots, folding chairs, a camera in a lap, the Gibson amplifier and the drum kit on the stage behind. "Entertainment at the EM Club in Ton Suhn Nhut. About 50 yards from my hooch."
researchNotes: Captioned with VN-0030 on 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0032-c18308461.json). The survey flagged a shoulder patch on the seated man at upper left as a magnification candidate for the unit question; it has not been read, and per the archive's rule no reading of any insignia is to appear on a page Larry browses or be described to him.
